{{Top|leg}}
A '''Particle Motivator''' acted as a starter for the ion acceleration process in [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] by using the kinetic energy acquired from a drop-launch in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or a ground-based repulsor launch to "kick-start" the [[Microparticle Ion Accelerator]]. The [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] used a Particle Motivator of [[Sarylcorp]] manufacture.
